request.initial_prompt: Menenius. Here comes the clusters.— And is Aufidius with him? You are they That made the air unwholesome when you cast Your stinking, greasy caps in hooting at Coriolanus' exile. Now he's coming, And not a hair upon a soldier's head Which will not prove a whip. As many coxcombs As you threw caps up will he tumble down And pay you for your voices. 'Tis no matter. If he could burn us all into one coal We have deserved it.
